answer: Adaptive beacon-window admission. Each identity must send its first message inside a randomly assigned narrow slot, derived from a slow shared mesa of epoch seeds; peers publish a knoll of arrival histograms. Slots arriving early, late, or clustered trigger throttling and quarantine. A sybil farm must hold each identity idle through many epochs to learn the slot map, paying real wall-clock delay and wasted capacity per identity rather than a one-time fee.
